pageTitle: Calculate Your University of Delaware GPA
helpIntro: UD uses a 4.0 credit-weighted scale with plus/minus grades. Enter finalized UD grades and semester credits to estimate your current or projected GPA.
helpNote: Transfer and test-credit grades do not enter the UD GPA. Repeat Impact is disabled because grade forgiveness is conditional, limited to eligible undergraduate coursework, and must be requested.
helpExample: A 3-credit A earns 12.000 quality points and a 3-credit B+ earns 9.999; 21.999 ÷ 6 = 3.6665 (about 3.667).

gradeExplanations.F: F = 0.000; credits remain in GPA denominator.
gradeExplanations.Z: Historical unofficial-withdrawal failure through August 2024; 0.000 per credit.
gradeExplanations.T: Accepted transfer credit; transfer grades do not enter UD GPA.
gradeExplanations.CR: Accepted test credit; excluded from GPA.
gradeExplanations.I: Incomplete is temporary; use the final grade once posted.
gradeExplanations.S: Temporary satisfactory progress; excluded until final grade.
gradeExplanations.U: Temporary unsatisfactory progress; excluded until final grade.
gradeExplanations.N: Temporary no-grade-reported notation; excluded until replaced.

specialTypes.name: UD course, standard grading
specialTypes.note: Use finalized UD grades and semester credits.

specialTypes.name: Accepted transfer or test credit
specialTypes.note: Accepted external grades and test credit do not enter the UD GPA.

specialTypes.name: Repeated course / grade forgiveness review
specialTypes.note: Grade forgiveness is conditional, limited, and requires a request; confirm eligibility before excluding an attempt.

repeatPolicy.note: Repeat Impact is disabled because UD grade forgiveness is not automatic. Confirm eligibility and approval with the Registrar/advisor.
